entities.name: Inca Conquest of Ecuador and the Kingdom of Quito
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Tupac Inca Yupanqui and Huayna Capac conquered Ecuador's highland peoples after fierce resistance, particularly from the Cañari. Huayna Capac favored Quito and fathered Atahualpa there. Upon his death (c. 1527), a devastating civil war erupted between Atahualpa (based in Quito) and his half-brother
